messages:
maria: heads-up — multiple customers reporting 504s from hosted inference since ~13:02 UTC, p99 spiking. I see continuous-batcher backlog and queue depth near hard limit for thinpool nodes. tenant=acme-payments
jon: :rotating_light: seeing same in dashboards, hosted-gateway request-queue depth at 98% on thinpool-3, dropouts starting at 13:04
ops-bot: alert: hosted.gateway.queue_depth.high on thinpool-3 (value=98%) — triggered 2025-11-05T13:03:12Z
ravi: any single tenant flooding? or many small tenants? logs show one tenant doing a large fanout bulk job
maria: traffic pattern points to a single tenant spike + some background long-seq requests. tenant_id=ten-4721
elaine: can we confirm kv-cache misses are high? continuous batching backlog often amplifies with K/V spinups
jon: trace snippets — gateway logs:
```
ERROR gateway: request enqueue timeout after 250ms (queue_depth=512/520) tenant=ten-4721 trace=tx-9b3f
WARN batcher: batch delay exceeded soft limit, spilling to slow-path
```
ravi: repro steps I ran locally: hammering endpoint with many short requests + intermittent long seqs causes batching to pile up. Repro command:
```
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi","max_tokens":1024}' & done
```
elaine: immediate mitigation — can we apply ephemeral rate-limit on ten-4721 and lower continuous-batcher max_batch_delay to 8ms for thinpool-3? Also I suggest enabling early-evict for long-seq requests
maria: support team got an angry ticket from acme-payments CS, passing along customer trace ids
support-bot: forwarded: ticket #CS-9832 customer_trace=tx-9b3f,tx-4a1e
jon: ops action plan: 1) add tenant throttle (burst=200/s, sustained=50/s) 2) reduce max_batch_delay on thinpool-3 to 8ms 3) toggle early-evict on longseqs 4) scale up thinpool by +1 node if queue stays high
ravi: I can push the throttle and batcher param change now. command:
```
# set tenant rate limit via admin API
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.example/v1/tenants/ten-4721/rate_limit \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"burst":200,"sustained":50}'
# lower batch delay
curl -X PATCH https://admin.redwood.example/v1/runtime/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"thinpool-3": {"continuous_batcher.max_batch_delay_ms":8}}'
```
elaine: after that, also enable fallback routing to dedicated-compatible-small model for this tenant while we investigate quality impact
maria: applied throttle at 13:07 UTC, batcher param change applied at 13:09 UTC, thinpool scaled +1 at 13:12 UTC
ops-bot: action log: tenant throttle set for ten-4721 by ravi at 2025-11-05T13:07:18Z
jon: post-change metrics look better — queue depth dropped to ~40% and p95 latency recovering. Customers still seeing some 504s but much less
ravi: root cause notes for postmortem: tenant bulk job combined with background long-sequence requests caused continuous-batcher backlog. Queue depth hit hard-coded limit and enqueue path started timing out. KV cache cold misses increased batch latency leading to tail-timeouts
elaine: follow-ups: add tenant spike detection runbook, add auto-throttle policy for thinpools, consider adaptive batch_delay per-tenant, and improve visibility for longseq spikes in console
maria: CS update posted to ticket and customer offered temporary dedicated fallback. Will monitor overnight and create postmortem doc
support-bot: ticket #CS-9832 updated by maria at 2025-11-05T13:35:02Z
jon: closing triage here — assigning postmortem to ravi and elaine. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
